# GitAuto (decommissioned)

Do not stage, commit, push, merge, or create a pull request from this legacy
surface. Closeout now uses the explicit `cstar-closeout` skill, which separates
evidence and handoff generation from operator-gated Git actions and forbids
broad, unreviewed staging.
